contexts.text: In the cloud flew owls and bats, (which) were appearances of their thoughts... For confirmations of Falsities so complete that they appear as Truths, are there represented under the forms of birds of night, whose eyes are illuminated by fatuous lumen, by which they see objects in the dark as though in light...
The daughters of the owl () = those who have falsified truths and perverted them into falsities.
